Command.Help.Body:
<color=#ffffbe>{0}</color> improves your vanilla Among Us experience with useful client-side features.
Open the pause menu to access more options and game settings.
Use <color=#e0b700>/commands</color> to see every available command.

Features:
- Host-side gameplay validation and manual moderation.
- Additional options for hosts.
- Enhanced settings to customize your game.
- Commands to manage and improve your experience.
- Client-side improvements and quality-of-life features.
